environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed behind AWS API Gateway WebSocket API, fronted by a Network Load Balancer with a VPC Link integration. The NLB has a target group health check on the API Gateway VPC endpoint. Inbound traffic is controlled by a Security Group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b3d5a7f9) attached to the NLB ENIs that permits TCP/443 only from three internal CIDR blocks: 10.128.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress), 172.20.0.0/14 (partner network peered via Transit Gateway), and 192.168.50.0/24 (monitoring subnet). The VPC endpoint policy additionally restricts execute-api:Invoke to principals within the AWS Organization (condition: aws:PrincipalOrgID = o-a1b2c3d4e5). DNS is configured via Route53 private hosted zone (ws-internal.corp.example.com) that resolves only within the VPC, with no public DNS record pointing to the NLB.
